value.text:
GitHub intake https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1494 belongs to the canonical open public-surface consistency owner. Full live metadata and verified history were reread. Current source confirms deprecated list-open/list-all spellings remain in the list unknown-field diagnostic and root help examples. Preserve compatibility aliases; follow up with canonical examples and an independently generated alias-refusal guard covering errors and help. This is intake only and no implementation claim is taken while completing the dependency cohort. Full report:

## What happens

On pm 2026.10.17, the CLI still teaches two deprecated commands in its own guidance, after #1303 fixed the help examples and the generated agent block:

```console
$ pm list --fields bogus
...
examples:
  - pm list-open --fields id,title,status,type,updated_at
  - pm list --fields id,title,parent,priority --limit 10
  - pm list-all --fields id,title,body --limit 5

$ pm list-all --limit 1
Deprecated command `list-all`; use `pm list --all`.
```

An agent that follows the error's first or third example gets a deprecation warning on the next call, so recovering from one error costs two extra round trips.

Sources on `main`:
- `src/sdk/query/list.ts` (the `unknown_field_projection` error): the `examples` array lists `pm list-open …` and `pm list-all …`.
- `src/cli/help-content.ts` `ROOT_HELP_BUNDLE.examples`: lists `pm list-open --limit 10`.

## Expected

Every example in errors, help bundles and generated guidance uses the canonical spelling: `pm list --status open …` and `pm list --all …`. The deprecation alias map in `src/sdk/cli-contracts/command-aliases.ts` already knows both replacements.

## Suggestion

A single guard would stop this class of regression for good. Add a test that collects every string under `examples` (help bundles, error details, guidance templates), parses its argv, and fails when it resolves to a deprecated alias. The existing `guidance-freshness` spec covers the generated block but not error `examples`.
